verdict_policy.PASS: All expected values and invariants met on identified source/config with actual evidence.
verdict_policy.PRODUCT FAIL: Valid oracle; execution available; product behavior violates expectation.
verdict_policy.MODEL ERROR: Invalid/unsupported extraction or fabricated evidence; never reclassify as a document gap.
verdict_policy.INFRA ERROR: Network/quota/timeout/environment execution failure; not business gap.
verdict_policy.ORACLE INVALID: Reference itself incorrect or unsupported; quarantine scenario.
verdict_policy.precedence: Record layer-specific failures: rejecting an injected bad model output can PASS the guardrail check while the injected extraction remains MODEL ERROR. A real end-to-end model error is not a successful business replay.
verdict_policy.no_retroactive_rehabilitation: A corrected invalid oracle cannot revive the same scenario as an event PASS; preserve prior version and explain limits.

evidence_required_per_case: reviewed mapping + citations + model call identity when relevant
expected comparison and layer-specific failure classification
rerun_protocol: Select immutable fixture and verify hashes.
Start isolated single-request run with stated initial state/units; no production integrations.
Capture extraction and review; exercise named actions in order.
Collect actual states, guidance, citations and downloaded export before comparison.
Compare against this contract without editing expected; retain failed attempts.
Reset and repeat the same input; source review stays intact; pending questions are not auto-resolved.
presentation_exclusions: All NOT_RUN/UNVERIFIED results and static screens are excluded from executed success claims.
Synthetic controls do not prove actual user demand or real PRD completeness.
No measured time saving, learned domain understanding, gap detection accuracy, winning odds or frontier-model necessity claim.
Past archive app tests and old demo-contract.json do not apply.
